limitations: Four selected previously examined public-development task clusters / six tests per arm; one technical repeat. This is not the complete 24-task/35-test development comparison or the planned two-repeat full E12 screen.
Selection bias, historical public-data exposure and unresolved checkpoint-training exposure preclude fresh-holdout or generalization claims.
Retained-candidate exact-match is a descriptive evaluator-side diagnostic. All tests remain in the denominator; missing slots are misses and no filler receives credit.
Qualified-test coverage is distinct from candidate correctness. Retained candidates do not repair missed native completion/deadline gates, permit promotion, or qualify this comparison.
No base/no-TTT control, randomization proof, repeatability evidence or qualified matched-compute comparison; no causal 64-versus-128 claim.
No locked confirmation truth was opened/projected/scored. No new GPU/model/provider work, official Kaggle score/readiness, method promotion or cost-reduction claim.
Per-test labels and answer-derived diagnostics remain evaluator-only and must not enter runtime packages, GPU bundles, solver features or configuration selection.

metric_definition.qualification: independent native completion/deadline/evidence gate, never inferred from exact match
metric_definition.top1: first retained attempt exact match, with absent attempt counted as incorrect
metric_definition.top2: any of the first two retained attempts exact match, with all six actual tests retained
